  # Calculate the percentage change for JPMorgan Chase
  jpm_change_2010 = Pattern A(value_JPM_2010, value_JPM_2009)
  jpm_change_2011 = Pattern A(value_JPM_2011, value_JPM_2010)
  jpm_change_2012 = Pattern A(value_JPM_2012, value_JPM_2011)
  jpm_change_2013 = Pattern A(value_JPM_2013, value_JPM_2012)
